title: Return month name in specified locale
question:
Using date_format we can extract month name from a date in English:

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
df = spark.createDataFrame([('2021-05-01',),('2021-06-01',)], ['c1']).select(F.col('c1').cast('date'))
df = df.withColumn('month', F.date_format('c1', 'LLLL'))
df.show()
#+----------+-----+
#|        c1|month|
#+----------+-----+
#|2021-05-01|  May|
#|2021-06-01| June|
#+----------+-----+

Desired - month names in French (ability to specify locale):

+----------+-----+
|        c1|month|
+----------+-----+
|2021-05-01|  mai|
|2021-06-01| juin|
+----------+-----+
answer:
Thanks to this clever guy, this is a very nice solution to return results in another language (locale):

df = df.withColumn('month', F.to_csv(F.struct('c1'), {'dateFormat': 'LLLL', 'locale': 'fr'}))

df.show()
#+----------+-----+
#|        c1|month|
#+----------+-----+
#|2021-05-01|  mai|
#|2021-06-01| juin|
#+----------+-----+
